detailed_descriptions_html.en:
◼︎Synopsis

Our protagonist "Kirsten" is a soldier troubled by her current way of life.

During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people,

and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

◼︎Game System

Classic command type RPG. 

【Difficulties】
There is two types of difficulties,

"enjoying the game" or "not interesting in the game part", no matter which type you can enjoy the game.

※After beating "Standard" difficulty, the bosses are really strong.

The author is heavily inspired by "Etr*an Odyssey"'s combat design,

This game is very different from simple games where you level up and continuously cast powerful skills!...Maybe

【Collectables】

"Monster Index"...records information on defeated monsters.

※All monsters are original illustrations. No template material is used, so you can enjoy a brand new experience.

◼︎Main Characters

Kirsten

The strongest female general in the Imperial Army.

She doesn't show it very well, but she is struggling with her current way of survival.

Aria

Emperor's personal Archmagician.

Has a lot of experience in many aspects. Undertands Kirsten very well, gives her a lot of advice.
